description: This file contains implementation of runtime logic for handling grain cancellation tokens in Orleans, including the runtime class, a serializer codec, and a surrogate struct, facilitating cancellation management and serialization within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenRuntime
classes.description: Implements runtime logic for cancelling grain operations, including retries and exception filtering.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenCodec
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of GrainCancellationToken objects using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenSurrogate
classes.description: Data transfer object used as a surrogate for serializing GrainCancellationToken instances.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a grain operation identified by GUID and manages related grain references.

methods.name: CancelTokenWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to cancel a remote grain token with retries and exception handling.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Creates a GrainCancellationToken from its surrogate form.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a GrainCancellationToken into its surrogate form for serialization.
